title: Causal Discovery for Fairness
findings: The paper's key findings are related to the methodology of causal discovery for fairness and do not involve religion. Religion is mentioned only as a theoretical example of a sensitive attribute, but it was not included as a variable in any of the experimental datasets (e.g., Compas, Adult, German credit) or analyses. The study focuses on sensitive attributes like race and sex.
